About the Old & Slow Ride group ride

Old & Slow Ride is a road group ride in Millbrook, AL. It rolls every Saturday at 7:00 am from Millbrook City Hall.

An easy Saturday ride north of Montgomery with a store stop halfway. About 16 miles, with more on offer if you want it. It has been on the club calendar most Saturdays this summer. First-time guests do not need to be members.
